subheader: Setup, migration and training: fees you pay once
lead: Each row names the service, its fee and what the fee covers. That third column answers questions before customers ask them.
note: The note holds what applies to every line: tax, invoice timing and surcharges for out-of-hours work.

fees.title: The service is the row header
fees.text: So screen readers announce which service each fee belongs to.

fees.title: The fee keeps its own column
fees.text: Figures use equal widths, so the amounts line up.

fees.title: What it covers is a sentence
fees.text: A full sentence, not a keyword, so readers know exactly what they pay for.

fees.title: A fee can be zero
fees.text: Showing €0 is clearer than leaving the row out.
